topic: Third LNG tank expansion (FID, schedule, JERA arrangement)
wiki_text: [CONFIRMED] Saibu Gas reached a final investment decision in November 2024 to expand the Hibiki LNG terminal with a third LNG storage tank of 230,000 m3 (vs 180,000 m3 each for the existing two tanks), plus an additional LNG vaporizer, BOG compressors, and LNG tank-truck loading facilities. Chiyoda Corporation was awarded the EPC contract; a groundbreaking ceremony was held on 18 July 2025, with completion targeted for the first half of fiscal year 2029. Estimated project cost is about US$330 million. In April 2025, Saibu Gas and JERA agreed that JERA will be able to use the new third tank under a capacity-sharing arrangement to manage supply-demand volatility; this is a commercial usage arrangement, not an equity stake (the terminal remains owned by Hibiki LNG Co Ltd, with parents Saibu Gas Holdings 90% and Kyushu Electric Power 10%).
